description.value: Home Restaurant is a long-established homestyle diner on the Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge's West Central neighbourhood, part of a small BC chain with four locations. It has served the community for over 20 years, with a menu centred on all-day breakfast, comfort classics, and house-made pies. Pickup and third-party delivery are both available, making it a flexible stop for cyclists on the Lougheed corridor.
